data.name: strAboutCredits
data.value:
mRemoteUG is a lean fork of mRemoteNG (github.com/mRemoteNG/mRemoteNG), which is itself the successor to mRemote by Felix Deimel. Nearly all of the code here was written by the mRemoteNG and mRemote authors and contributors; this fork narrows the scope and modernises the platform, and takes nothing away from their work.
The full list of contributors is in Credits.txt, installed beside the executable.
Includes PuTTY (© Simon Tatham, MIT), Serilog (© Serilog Contributors, Apache 2.0) and the Fluent UI System Icons (© Microsoft Corporation, MIT).
